entities.summary: Cheavon Clarke is a Jamaican-born British-French professional boxer. At regional level, he held the British cruiserweight title from May 2024 to April 2025. As an amateur, he won a silver medal at the 2017 European Championships; and bronze at the 2018 Commonwealth and 2019 European Games.
